These are the webpages of Jeffrey Ketland. I retired in late 2025 from the University of Warsaw, where I was a Research Professor working on a project externally funded by the National Science Center (NCN), Kraków, Poland. My primary research interest is Philosophy of Science. Prior to Warsaw, I have worked at the London School of Economics, where I obtained my PhD; and Kings College London; and the Universities of Nottingham, Cambridge, Leeds, Edinburgh, Munich and Oxford. 

My CV can be found via the link in the sidebar. The other links in the sidebar include:

* Some lecture notes that I have written over the years.

* My research & publications.

* Some blogposts and links to an older blog and to Substack.

* Some Shiny apps.
